tasks.answer: Batch compensation workspace screen (standard / special / review steps) for flight-delay compensation, exportName FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen, layer=feature. batchId is the only required prop; the screen additionally needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) list variant exists in the catalog; the closest match is the generic paginated traveler booking list TravelerBookingListScreen (exportName TravelerBookingListScreen, layer=feature), which has search and filters. Required prop: navigate (initialStatus is optional); queries and actions are permission-gated.
tasks.notes: Searched '特殊旅客预订列表 special passenger booking list' — results contained only generic booking-list components (TravelerBookingListScreen, BookingStatusBadge) plus generic shared-ui list parts (InfiniteListFooter, UiList); nothing special-passenger specific.

tasks.answer: Feature-level PasswordInput (layer=feature) has no required props; it renders a password field with show/hide labels. Error display: it takes an error string and must be used inside UiFormField — the form-field wrapper renders the error message. A shared-ui twin also exists: ui.UiPasswordInput from '@/components/ui/form' (layer=shared-ui, requiredProps showLabel, hideLabel) where error is a boolean and the message likewise comes from the surrounding UiFormField, so the UiFormField wrapper is required in both variants.

relatedComponents.note: error is boolean; must be used inside UiFormField for the error message.

tasks.answer: Both live in the shared-ui mobile business module (layer=shared-ui, same barrel '@/components/business/mobile'): (1) SearchBar — required props value, placeholder, onChange; onFilter optionally adds the filter icon button. (2) FilterSheet — required props visible, title, children, onClose; onConfirm runs before the sheet closes, with reset and confirm actions.

relatedComponents.note: Bottom filter sheet with reset and confirm actions.

tasks.answer: Global auth recovery dialog (layer=shared-ui), exportName AuthRecoveryDialog, no required props. It subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; mount it once near the app root — it renders null while no recovery event is pending. The inner view is common.AuthRecoveryDialogView ('@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog-view', required prop detail).
